abstract: The article presents an autosomal dominant Currarino syndrome with incomplete penetrance in three out of four members of the same family. The mother had only a bony sacral defect and no other signs. In the older daughter, the syndrome was completely developed with presacral cystic teratoma, a sacral defect and abdominal discomfort. The younger daughter had no clinical or imaging features of the disease. The only son harboured presacral meningocele, urinary stenosis and a sacral defect. The daughter and son with developed variants of the syndrome were successfully operated on and are now symptom free.
abstract_ja: 本論文は、ある家系の4名中3名で不完全浸透を示す常染色体優性Currarino症候群を提示する。母親は仙骨の骨欠損のみで他の所見はなかった。年長の娘は、仙骨前嚢胞性奇形腫、仙骨欠損、腹部不快感を伴う完全な症候群を発症していた。年少の娘には臨床的・画像的な所見はなかった。息子は仙骨前髄膜瘤、尿路狭窄、仙骨欠損を有していた。症候群の発症型を示した娘と息子は手術を受け、現在は無症状である。
